problem: Consider a cube such that the length of each side $s$ varies. What is the best interpretation of ${V}^{′}(s)$ if $V$ is the volume of the cube?

choices.value: The rate at which the surface area of the cube changes as each side changes
The volume of a cube with side $s$
The rate at which the volume changes as each side changes
The length of each side of the cube
The rate at which each side changes as the volume changes
